t: PEV fields and pre-closeout dogfooding driven into framework skills
description: Two signal-level advancements driven into the lug advisor and closeout skills: (1) PEV fields (perceive/execute/verify) now REQUIRED on all actionable lugs — transforms lugs from decision records into workable tickets. (2) Dogfooding step added to closeout — all lugs created/modified during a session are validated for self-containment, PEV completeness, and naive-agent readability before commit. Both changes propagate to all spokes via spoke-upgrade.sh. Root cause: sub-agent dogfood test revealed 8/17 lugs were unworkable without conversation context.
